body:
23 Nov 2026, P2-25 SLICE 4, PR #118, THIRD REVIEW ROUND (built, not walked, not deployed; P2-25 stays todo). A read-only reviewer and an adversarial tester ran on 506bf42; both changes-needed; every item reproduced by the lead with a failing test FIRST (files and probes saved in local/rescued-23nov/).
BLOCKERS FIXED: (1) ARRIVAL (tester, proved): a library file the SCAN attaches to a worklist ref DURING the pass (added_at >= began) was never judged by that pass (begin() could not read it; _release and _nobody_could_judge ignored it): pass 2 wrote, and a cut-and-resumed pass ended elsewhere (held, no merge) than the uncut one (released and merged). Rehome.page() notes such rows (an arrivals set), _release and _nobody_could_judge consult it. (2) MADE BY NAME (reviewer): the files judged again after a move were found by the ISRC of a made song only; a song made by name displaces the tombstone that answered a kept file: _files_naming judges again every kept or moved file whose refs.candidates now include a made song (any tier). (3) the guard `if moved` had no test (25 rounds + an ERROR each pass of a Host with a held ref): test, mutant red.
CONCERNS FIXED: the MAX_ROUNDS cap puts the files still queued into _undecided (MAX_ROUNDS=1 released a held ref and merged a pair); scanner._prune gave the newest copy the preferred flag without taking it from the one that had it (OLD CODE ON MAIN, audit B-137: three files, one lost that was not the preferred one: two preferred, the newer played): now refs.ensure_one_preferred; HOLDS: the placeholder row says the ids name no song, the ambiguous row says which remedy frees which kind; docs/18: the prune is ONE transaction (0.74 s quiet, 1.49 s loaded at 200,000 refs); the cost 'a gap stays empty until a scan describes it' corrected (the scan never enriches an owned song).
WHY THE GENERATORS WERE BLIND: test_rehome_worlds wrote no ref_merge rows and listed no song without a row; it writes both now (own RNG, old worlds unchanged), a fifth variant kills the pass before its release, seeds 24 and 46 (red on 506bf42) are in SEEDS. Every earlier '0 of N' holds only for the classes then generated.
PROOF: 7 mutants of the round's guards, all red against a green baseline of 84; whole server suite 2688 passed, 13 skipped, 1 xfailed (pytest exit 0, output to a file); ruff, format, mypy (75 files), check_rows, check_order clean; 500 fresh seeded worlds (0-499) with tombstones and arrivals: 0 violations.
SEAM (accepted, reasoned): the last-file guard trusts a row attached after the pass began although the listing lacks its id. Every attach_file writer takes the id from the music server (keeper: _wait_for_music_server; migration: a song the music server returned; scan: the listing), so a row whose id the listing NEVER has needs a music server whose search and listing disagree; the hourly prune already removes such a row today.
NOT DONE: the independent look at THIS round (the same reviewer and tester are asked), the walk, any deploy.
